## Personality

Mirabel Cotton is a noisy, sunburned, and reckless individual. She also takes great pride in having a large number of deceased relatives, frequently detailing how each of them passed away.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v3 ch.Transgressors P34](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0034)_

## History

Mirabel Cotton experienced significant family tragedy, having lost nearly all of her grandparents, uncles, and aunts. At school, she frightened [Dora](../character/dora.md) by sharing stories about her family's ghosts. She later played and went fishing with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) after [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) coerced his sister into skipping [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v3 ch.Transgressors P23](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0023), [v3 ch.Transgressors P37](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0037), +2 more_
